payload.summary: Searched for a published dealer procedure fixing the third card's orientation and position: Wizard of Odds, Vegas-Aces' mini-baccarat dealing course, the Massachusetts Gaming Commission baccarat rules, the California AG commission-free baccarat filing, Venetian and Cache Creek house guides. NOTHING documents it. Every published rule set specifies WHEN the third card is drawn and never WHERE the dealer lays it — Vegas-Aces explicitly defers physical delivery to 'your casino's specific house dealing procedures manual'. Conclusion: the sideways third card is house visual practice, not regulation, so there is no external authority to appeal to and no rule this delta can violate. Jim's attached reference photo of a live EZ Baccarat layout is the governing reference, and the app ALREADY rotates the third card 90deg — this delta only changes which SIDE of the pair it lies on. Sources: https://www.vegas-aces.com/learn/deal-mini-baccarat/ , https://massgaming.com/wp-content/uploads/Rules-Baccarat-6-20-18.pdf , https://oag.ca.gov/sites/all/files/agweb/pdfs/gambling/BGC_cfb.pdf
